subject.title: Android: Add message copy and text selection to chat screen

question: Should Android chat message long-press ship as a narrow Copy/Select Copy feature, or should it include the broader Share and Reply actions requested here?
rationale: The current source gap is clear, but the requested action set changes Android chat UX and Reply semantics, and prior PR attempts show this is not only a mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Approve copy-first scope
options.body: Implement Copy and Select Copy for normal chat text first, preserving scroll and link behavior, and track Share/Reply separately if maintainers still want them.

options.title: Approve full action menu
options.body: Adopt the full Copy, Select Copy, Share, and Reply action sheet, accepting the need to define reply-message semantics and broader UI proof.

options.title: Defer message actions
options.body: Leave the Android chat behavior unchanged for now and close or decline the linked implementation attempts as product scope not accepted.

recommendation.title: Approve copy-first scope
recommendation.body: Implement Copy and Select Copy for normal chat text first, preserving scroll and link behavior, and track Share/Reply separately if maintainers still want them.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent commit history shows the strongest current-main activity across the affected Android chat files and adjacent Android chat behavior.
